dataset.name: Global Music Genre Taxonomy
dataset.purpose: Country-aware music genre selection for apps. Show a shared global catalogue first, then regional and country-specific genres.
dataset.coverage: 196 country/territory records: 193 UN member states plus Palestine, Vatican City and Kosovo.
dataset.importantNote: Genres are cultural classifications, not exclusive country ownership. Many styles cross borders, have multiple names, or are shared by neighboring communities.
dataset.uiRecommendation: When a user selects a country, merge globalGenreIds + regionalGenreIds + localGenres, then de-duplicate by normalized genre name.
